proposal.summary: The report describes an unauthenticated remote code execution via an upload endpoint in the GLPI Cartography (positions) plugin (versions < 6.0.0) allowing an attacker to upload a PHP file and execute commands.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerable plugin version by reproducing the upload and command execution in a controlled environment, then remove or patch the plugin and block the upload endpoint; contact vendor for patch and publish coordinated advisory.

evidence_quotes.claim: HTTP request showing upload to an upload.php endpoint with a filename parameter
Proof-of-concept PHP payload demonstrating command execution

evidence_quotes.quote: Exploit Title: GLPI  Cartography Plugin v6.0.0 - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
